notes.title: The BIG v2.0 Cooking Companions Update!
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to announce that Cooking Companions has received a HUGE update! Patch notes below.

Be sure to wishlist/check out the sequel, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2399060/Dread_Weight/]Dread Weight,[/url]  releasing in THREE DAYS on [b]Monday July 29th![/b] Leave a review on release day if you want to help support development.

[previewyoutube=NSBZq2xRE3M;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
-The entire script for Cooking Companions has been revised! Read more about it [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1263230/discussions/0/4417551094436356161/]here.[/url]
-New secrets have been added to the game: see if you can find them all!
-A new animated ghost scene has been added!
-Various bugs have been fixed!

[h2]Lots o' Assets![/h2]
Making a TikTok or something Cooking Companions related? You now have access to most of the sprites and artwork! Just navigate to your Steam files to find the folder. Just use #CookingCompanions or #DreadWeight. We'll promote the best fan made content!

For updates: check out [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@deerdreamstudios]TikTok[/url],[url=https://www.deerdreamstudios.com/]the site[/url] or [url=https://twitter.com/DeerDreamStudio]follow us on Twitter[/url] (and Threads!)

Missing some endings? Check them all out on our [url=https://www.youtube.com/@DeerDreamStudios/videos]YouTube channel.[/url] Like and subscribe to help out!

Have a great day everyone: enjoy!

-Deer Dream Studios

notes.title: BIG FREE UPDATE is live!
notes.notes:
[h1]IT'S HERE[/h1]

The big story update is LIVE! Enjoy a few more hours of content in an all new chapter: "Chompettes Origins".


-Nightmare mode has received an overhaul as well: more events and endings throughout it!
-Four endings have been added to the game!
-More horror: featuring the works of Sam "Ice" Woodrick (Lily's Well), Nikki Kalpa (THEY SPEAK FROM THE ABYSS), and other incredible artists!
-DOUBLE the achievements: go secret hunting, or aim for a specific ending!
-More music: over 
-Additional NG+ events!

[h2]How to Unlock in 10 seconds or less[/h2]
1. Click the "New Game" button from the main menu. 
2. Play the game normally until you reach the first line of dialogue.
3. Go the main menu, hit the new game button.
4. You'll now see "Chompettes Origins" selectable. Alternatively: just play through the game and you'll see the new content!

[previewyoutube=Pswj4zwl6Kc;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Performance Improvements on Older Computers[/h2]
Having performance issues with an older computer? This may be due to the engine rendering: try this, Shift+G, then select a different rendering method. Restart the game and see if that fixes it!

[h2]What if I've already played Cooking Companions?[/h2]
Play through Chompettes Origins and go through Nightmare Mode and NG+: content has been added to everything past a fresh "normal" playthrough!

[h2]I'm getting an error message when I try a new game![/h2]
With internal testing: we discovered there is a chance your older save files are causing an issue with the update. There are two ways to fix this: 

1) Open Steam
2) Go into the Library tab
3) Right-click Cooking Companions
4) Go to Manage > Browse Local Files
5) Go back to the previous folder (the folder that showed when you pressed "Browse local files" on Steam)
6) Select all the content inside this folder and delete it
7) Go back to your Steam Library
8) Right-click over Cooking Companions;
9) Manage > Uninstall to uninstall your game
10) Install the game again

OR uninstall Cooking Companions and delete the folder at Program Files>Steam>steamapps>common>Cooking Companions

Coming soon: survive ANY basement with the help of Cabbage! Check it out [url=https://shop.makeship.com/3AMGS1y]here[/url]
